description: Game display names for exoplanet-catalog systems, stars, and planets (D24, EX-5.4a). Keys are stable IDs: systems by system ID, stars by star ID, planets by planet ID. displayName falls back to the HYG proper name, then the catalog name, when no entry exists. Hand-maintained: the monthly refresh never writes this file. Phase 5 seeds only well-known names; settler names come later (plan N1).

sources.name: IAU NameExoWorlds 2015
sources.note: IAU-approved exoplanet names. Host-star names already arrive through AT-HYG proper names (IAU WGSN).
